message.content: How many hosts are being monitored? The API Key is 'gorilla-123'

function.name: get_monitoring_state
function.description: Returns the count of hosts currently being monitored by the infrastructure resources API. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

api_key.description: The API key used to authenticate requests to the infrastructure resources API.

environment.description: Specifies the environment for which the host monitoring count is required, such as 'production' or 'development'.

include_inactive.description: Determines whether to include inactive hosts in the count.

function.name: InfrastructureCatalogApi_get_infrastructure_catalog_plugins
function.description: Retrieve a list of all available plugin identifiers that can be used to monitor the system. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

function.name: get_website_catalog_metrics
function.description: Retrieve a list of all available metric definitions used for website monitoring. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

category.description: The category of metrics to retrieve, such as 'performance' or 'availability'.

include_deprecated.description: A flag to determine if deprecated metrics should be included in the results.
